slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Daily effort exciting nahi hota, par wahi long-term change banata hai.
Kuch din effort karke proof na mile, to hum aksar quit kar dete hain.
Daily small improvement ek din me nahi, months me clearly visible hoti hai.
Same time, same cue, same minimum action—habit easy ban jaati hai.
Ek goal choose karo. Daily minimum define karo. Miss ho to next day restart.
Jo habit tum repeat kar sakte ho, wahi tumhari life change kar sakti hai.

caption:
Consistency boring lag sakti hai, lekin change wahi create karti hai.

Ek small habit choose karo aur use 30 din tak repeat karo.
